title: Simulation Result V1 (sealed)
description: What a run actually produced, SEALED machine-side by ldyf.closure.seal_run_result from the RunResults the simulator returned. Names the byte-identity of every artefact the extractor will re-read. Nothing here is a metric or a claim; metrics are derived later by a registered extractor. An LLM never writes this document (DNA-07).

artifacts.description: name -> {file (relative, traversal-free), sha256}. closure_effect_v1 requires baseline_tripinfo, ruled_tripinfo, baseline_record_manifest, baseline_record_frames, ruled_record_manifest, ruled_record_frames.

result_hash.description: SHA-256 over this document with result_hash blanked, canonical JSON. See ldyf.evidence.

run_report.description: Simulator-side RunResult figures, sealed for audit: exit code, steps, output validity, teleports, honest reroute accounting (requests / successes / routes_actually_changed / unchanged / failures), vehicles_on_closed_lane_at_closure, post_closure_entries_onto_closed_edges (measured from the FCD; must be 0), lanes closed, and the SUMO flags used. NOT re-derived by the extractor except post_closure_entries.
